title: SWF: PlaceObject2 matrix and depth encoding
description: Unit tests for PlaceObject2 tag binary encoding in packages/swf. Verify that x/y translation, scale, rotation, depth are correctly written into the MATRIX record. Test at packages/swf/src/__tests__/placeobject2.test.ts. Import encodeMatrix from swf internals and verify bit-exact output for known transforms.
